title: React 19.3.0 upgrade across console-lab and console-ui
summary: This change bumps the React runtime from 18.3.1 to 19.3.0 for the console-lab app and the console-ui package, and re-resolves the pnpm lockfile so every React-dependent package (react-aria-components, react-aria, react-stately, @testing-library/react) is re-keyed onto the new peer. The console-ui peer range moves to ^19.3.0, so a consumer still on React 18 no longer satisfies it. No application source changed: the blast radius is the dependency graph and the two manifests that pin it.

nodes.label: console-lab
nodes.subtitle: apps/console-lab
nodes.summary: The lab application. Its package.json now pins react and react-dom at 19.3.0 instead of 18.3.1, which is the runtime the app actually mounts.

nodes.label: console-ui
nodes.subtitle: packages/console-ui
nodes.summary: The shared component library. Its peerDependencies range moved from ^18.3.1 to ^19.3.0 and its devDependencies now install 19.3.0 for tests.

nodes.label: pnpm-lock.yaml
nodes.subtitle: workspace resolution
nodes.summary: The single file where the upgrade actually lands: importer specs, package entries and snapshot peer keys all move from 18.3.1 to 19.3.0.

nodes.label: react
nodes.summary: The React runtime itself. The lockfile drops react@18.3.1 and adds react@19.3.0; the 19.2.7 entry used elsewhere in the workspace is untouched.

nodes.label: react-dom
nodes.summary: The DOM renderer. Its 18.3.1 entry, which pulled in loose-envify, is replaced by 19.3.0, which depends only on react and scheduler.

nodes.label: scheduler
nodes.summary: React's scheduler. The 0.23.2 entry (which depended on loose-envify) is removed and 0.28.0 is added for the 19.3.0 renderer.

nodes.label: loose-envify
nodes.summary: A transitive dependency of React 18's runtime and scheduler. It disappears entirely from the lockfile because React 19 no longer needs it.

nodes.label: react-aria-components
nodes.summary: The component primitives used by console-ui. Same version, but its peer resolution is re-keyed from react@18.3.1 to react@19.3.0.

nodes.label: react-aria
nodes.summary: Transitive of react-aria-components. Re-resolved against react@19.3.0 and react-dom@19.3.0.

nodes.label: react-stately
nodes.summary: State management for react-aria. Its peer key moves to react@19.3.0.

nodes.label: @testing-library/react
nodes.summary: The test renderer used by console-ui's devDependencies. Its peer resolution now points at react-dom@19.3.0 and react@19.3.0.

edges.label: workspace:*
edges.summary: The app consumes the component library as a workspace dependency; unchanged by this PR but it is why the peer bump matters.
The app's direct pin on React moved from 18.3.1 to 19.3.0. This is the change the PR is about.
The app's direct pin on react-dom moved from 18.3.1 to 19.3.0.
The peer range widened upward: consumers must now supply React 19.3.0 or later, so a React 18 host no longer satisfies console-ui.
The react-dom peer range moved to ^19.3.0 alongside React itself.

edges.label: 19.3.0 (dev)
edges.summary: The library's own devDependency installs 19.3.0 so its tests run against the same runtime it now requires.

edges.label: peer ^19.3.0
edges.summary: react-dom@19.3.0 declares react ^19.3.0 as its peer, replacing the ^18.3.1 peer of the removed 18.3.1 entry.
The renderer now pulls scheduler 0.28.0 instead of 0.23.2.

edges.label: no longer needed
edges.summary: React 18's renderer depended on loose-envify; the 19.3.0 entry does not, so the package leaves the lockfile.

edges.label: no longer needed
edges.summary: scheduler 0.23.2 depended on loose-envify; 0.28.0 has no dependencies at all.

edges.label: peer re-keyed
edges.summary: The package version is unchanged, but its peer resolution key in the lockfile moved from react@18.3.1 to react@19.3.0.
The transitive react-aria snapshot is re-resolved against the new React peer.
The transitive react-stately snapshot is likewise re-keyed onto react@19.3.0.

edges.label: peer re-keyed
edges.summary: The test renderer's peer resolution moved to react@19.3.0 and react-dom@19.3.0.

edges.label: 18.3.1 to 19.3.0
edges.summary: The lockfile is where the version swap is recorded for every importer and snapshot.

edges.label: 18.3.1 to 19.3.0
edges.summary: The lockfile records the react-dom swap and its new scheduler dependency.
